Eastern province provincial council
Notices issued by the Governor of Eastern Province

BY the virtue of powers vested in me, under the Article 154C of the 13th Amendment to the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka I, M. Senthil Thondaman, Governor of Eastern Province, do hereby notify that the subjects of the Ministries and Cluster of Eastern Provincial Council shown in the following Schedule - I is hereby amended as shown in the Schedule - II with effect from 01st June 2024.
